why: Spa and wellness centres sell package sessions (e.g. 10-session bundles) with expiry, private room scheduling and client preference tracking. The key is package sales, expiry tracking and client consent.
operator: The spa manager oversees package sales, room scheduling and client preference records. Their day is package sales, expiry tracking and room assignments.
entities: Spa (id, nameAr, nameEn, branchId, address, phone, currency, taxRegistration, openingHours)
Package (id, spaId, nameAr, nameEn, sessionCount, pricePiasters, expiryDays, isActive, features)
Client (id, spaId, name, phone, preferencesAr, preferencesEn, consentPhotos, visitCount, totalSpentPiasters, lastVisit)
Room (id, spaId, label, capacity, status, bookedBy, bookedAt, expiresAt)
Appointment (id, roomId, clientId, dateTime, duration, serviceType, status, notes)
PackageRedemption (id, packageId, clientId, sessionsUsed, sessionsRemaining, expiryDate, status, redeemedAt)
batches: No : spa carries no stock or expiry (package expiry is tracked via expiryDays and expiryDate)
expiry: Packages have expiry days from purchase and an expiry date; sessions must be used before expiry
special: The core structures are the package with session count and expiry, the client with preference tracking and photo consent, the room scheduling and the redemption tracker. Package expiry is the key differentiator from other service sectors.
screens: Package catalogue: list of packages with session count, price, expiry days, features (fast lane, private room, etc.), activate/deactivate
Client profile: name, phone, preferences, consent flag for photos, visit count, total spent, last visit, active redemptions
Room scheduler: available rooms per time slot, book room, assign client, mark status (available/booked/free)
Package redemption: select package, view sessions used/remaining, expiry date, update status (active/used/expired)
Appointment scheduler: select room, date/time, service type, client, status (scheduled/in-progress/completed)
Redemption history: all redemptions per client, sessions used, remaining, expiry events
Staff shift: clock in/out, client load per hour, notes
roles: Owner: everything : packages, clients, rooms, appointments, redemptions, reports, billing
Therapist: view appointments, mark in-progress/completed, view client preferences
Front desk: package sales, client check-in, room booking, redemption processing
Manager: package creation, pricing, therapist scheduling, reports
reports: Package sales revenue: total per period, per package, sessions used vs total per package
Package expiry rate: how many packages expired per period, how many sessions lost
Client retention: visit count per client, total spent per client, re-book rate
Room utilisation: booked hours vs available per period, peak times
Therapist workload: appointments per period, utilisation rate per therapist
integrations: Esc/POS thermal printer for receipts and package redemptions
WhatsApp deep link for package renewal notices and appointment reminders
Email for invoice and package expiry notices (opt-in)
onboarding: Spa basics: name, branch, address, phone, currency, working hours
Initial packages: the starting packages (5-session, 10-session, 20-session) with price, expiry days and features
Client intake: the fields collected (name, phone, preferences, photo consent)
Staff: add the initial team with their role templates
First week plan: create first package, first client, first room booking
seed: No sector-specific seed data. The engine provides the package with expiry and role templates.

tasks.title: Add package catalogue with expiry days and features
tasks.brief: Build the package catalogue: list of packages with session count, price, expiry days, features, activate/deactivate. Done when the catalogue loads and displays packages with correct expiry and features.
tasks.done: When package catalogue displays live data with expiry and features

tasks.title: Add client profile with preferences and photo consent
tasks.brief: Build the client profile: name, phone, preferences Ar/En, consent flag for photos, visit count, total spent, last visit. Done when the profile saves and displays correct data.
tasks.done: When client profile works and displays live data with consent flag

tasks.title: Add room scheduler with available slots per time
tasks.brief: Build the room scheduler: available rooms per time slot, book room, assign client, mark status. Done when the scheduler saves the booking and displays availability correctly.
tasks.done: When room scheduler works end-to-end with availability display

tasks.title: Add package redemption screen
tasks.brief: Build the redemption screen: select package, view sessions used/remaining, expiry date, update status (active/used/expired). Done when the redemption saves and the status updates correctly.
tasks.done: When package redemption works end-to-end with status tracking

tasks.title: Add appointment scheduler with room and client
tasks.brief: Build the appointment screen: select room, date/time, service type, client, status (scheduled/in-progress/completed). Done when the appointment saves and the room status updates correctly.
tasks.done: When appointment scheduler works end-to-end with room status update

tasks.title: Add redemption history per client
tasks.brief: Build the history screen: all redemptions per client, sessions used, remaining, expiry events. Done when the history pulls and displays client's full redemption trail.
tasks.done: When redemption history works and displays live data

tasks.title: Add package expiry rate report
tasks.brief: Build the report showing how many packages expired per period and how many sessions lost. Done when the report computes from Firestore and displays correct figures.
tasks.done: When package expiry rate report computes correctly from live data

tasks.title: Add room utilisation report
tasks.brief: Build the report showing booked hours vs available per period, peak times. Done when the report computes from Firestore and displays correct figures.
tasks.done: When room utilisation report computes correctly from live data

tasks.title: Add therapist workload report
tasks.brief: Build the report showing appointments per period, utilisation rate per therapist. Done when the report computes from Firestore and displays correct figures.
tasks.done: When therapist workload report computes correctly from live data

tasks.title: Add onboarding flow for initial spa wellness setup
tasks.brief: Build the onboarding flow: spa basics, initial packages, client intake fields, staff addition. Done when the flow completes and the spa appears with all defaults.
tasks.done: When onboarding flow works end-to-end and spa is created

risks: Encryption key loss makes client and package records unrecoverable
WhatsApp template rejection if not approved by Meta
Package expiry without clear purchase-date linkage can violate consumer protection law
Photo consent storage without proper legal basis can violate PDPL
